title: New Steps in Japanese Studies
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: The volume offers the results of the 3 years joint research project Innovative Japanese Studies through International Cooperation: The Fostering of Young Researchers by Cooperation with Overseas Institutes of Japanese Studies (Graduate School of Humanities, Kobe University, JSPS funds), developed among Kobe University, Hamburg University, Oxford University and Ca' Foscari University.
